summary_1line: The Brahmana enumerates cosmic and symbolic 'firsts' in nature, society, and ritual, emphasizing the transient nature of all things except knowledge.

image_candidates.scene_text: The golden Mount Meru rises at the center of the world while the sacred Ganga flows down from the heavens across the three realms.
A sage teaches beside a sacrificial fire as the syllable Om, the sun, and the life-breath Prana are symbolically depicted as the origins of all knowledge and life.
